name: Spoonful of Sugar
source:
To wake up in an unfamiliar room is one thing. To have the memories of your past in pieces is another. You can't remember what happened that caused you to arrive here, and any attempt to recall your past results in a horrific headache.

Stranger still, a gentle fae named Casimir insists you have history. He insists he knows you. He insists he loves you. All you need to do is take your medicine when he provides it, for it'll ease the pounding in your head.

If only it could help you remember your name.

[From [url=https://hydrastudio.itch.io/spoonful-of-sugar]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在陌生的房间里醒来是一回事，过往的记忆碎成一地残片则是另一回事。你完全想不起究竟发生了什么才会流落至此，而每一次试图回想过去的努力，都会引发一阵撕心裂肺的剧烈头痛。

更蹊跷的是，一位名叫卡西米尔的温柔妖精坚称你们二人颇有渊源。他坚称自己认识你。他坚称自己深爱着你。你唯一需要做的，便是在他递上汤药时乖乖服下，好缓解脑海中突突直跳的剧痛。

要是这副药也能帮你想起自己的名字就好了。

[摘自[url=https://hydrastudio.itch.io/spoonful-of-sugar]itch.io[/url]]
